not_listed.detail: Searching by words only: Eugene lists no search model named nomic-embed. Check the Search model setting in Eugene's console.

not_search_model.detail: Searching by words only: gemma-3 is not a search model. Choose one in the Search model setting in Eugene's console.

outside.detail: Searching by words only: text-embedding-3-small runs on OpenAI, outside your machines, and the owner has not allowed sending your documents' text there.

outside_only.headline: Searching by words only. No search model is running.
outside_only.detail: Searching by words only: the only search models Eugene lists run outside your machines (text-embedding-3-small), and the owner has not allowed sending your documents' text there.

unreachable.headline: Searching by words only.
unreachable.detail: Searching by words only: Eugene's gateway could not be reached.

key.headline: Searching by words only.
key.detail: Searching by words only: The gateway refused Workbench's key.

limited.headline: Searching by words only.
limited.detail: Searching by words only: this Workbench's key is at its limit (too many requests), so a question could not be searched by meaning. The owner can raise the key's limits in Eugene's console.

slow.headline: Searching by words only.
slow.detail: Searching by words only: The gateway took too long to answer.

refused.headline: Searching by words only.
refused.detail: Searching by words only: the search model Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0 refused the request (the input is empty).

error.headline: Searching by words only.
error.detail: Searching by words only: the search model Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0 failed (the engine stopped).

changed.headline: Search by meaning is paused: this search was built with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0 and nomic-embed-text-v1.5 is running now.
changed.detail: Your documents are searched by words until you choose Rebuild, which adds meaning again with the model that is running.

dimension.headline: Search by meaning is paused: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0 now gives 768 numbers for each passage, and this search was built with 1,024.
dimension.detail: Your documents are searched by words until you choose Rebuild, which adds meaning again with the model that is running.

damaged.headline: Search by meaning is off: what this search was built with is unreadable (not JSON). Your files are safe. Rebuild adds meaning again.
